name: ⚽ MPS 4-a-side
desc:
❗ Experience the sensation of modern fast-paced soccer / football like never before in MPS 4-a-side! The field is your canvas, limited only by your imagination. Get ready for your amazing career by playing in a variety of game modes which provide realistic simulations of the different leagues in the sport. With smooth game controls, you possess the power to be as creative as you want with your players playstyle.

🎁 Join our group for 10% more XP, 10% more Daily Rewards, and free exclusive celebrations.

🎨 Game art created by Osmany1739, Silo_exe, motorninjasuper12, Zun_ned, Nachosx1, mbappve
